# Read the organization's spend budget

>
The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work — chat, evals, judges and computer time — in the current bil
ling window, and how much of it has been spent.\n\nAny member may read it: a member who cannot raise the ceiling still needs to kn
ow it exists, because it is what refused their run. `capUsd: null` means the organization is uncapped, which is the default.\n\nRu
ns that use your own provider keys are never counted against the budget and never blocked by it. Neither is the free daily allowan

ce — it is not credits.



## OpenAPI

````yaml /reference/openapi.json get /organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget

 The pre-rename paths — `/projects/{projectId}/scenarios`,

ervations are an explicit opt-in whose model cost is on\n MCPJam — no credits are consumed — and they can never decide a verd

ict.

 Search the scraped MCP directories (Claude, ChatGPT, and any future

urce), list curated/org registry cards, and install them into a project.\n Install writes a `servers` row and provenance — it

ds require a bearer (including minted guest tokens)\n but do not materialize a user. Card/connection reads and all writes are

authed-non-guest.
 - name: Feedback

 Feedback about MCPJam itself (bugs, missing capabilities
, confusing\n behavior), sent to the MCPJam team and kept for 180 days. The\n `send_feedback` MCP tool calls the same en

dpoint.
